name: Growning Things Up
source:
Growing Things Up is an engaging 18+ visual novel date sim where you play as a young man who is in a new city, brimming with expectations and insecurities.

However, things take an intriguing turn when you are mistakenly placed as a guest in a dorm where only women are allowed. In this place you will meet beautiful girls with outstanding personalities who will need your help to better explore their sexualities and fetishes. Now it's up to you to find ways and breath to dive into the sordid desires that some pretty faces can hide.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/kinkbr/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Growing Things Up》是一款引人入胜的18岁以上视觉小说约会模拟游戏，你将扮演一名来到新城市的年轻人，充满期望和不安全感。

然而，当你被错误地安排为只允许女性入住的宿舍的客人时，事情发生了有趣的转变。在这里，你将遇到具有杰出个性的美丽女孩，她们需要你的帮助来更好地探索她们的性取向和恋物癖。现在，你需要找到方法和呼吸来深入了解一些漂亮面孔所隐藏的肮脏欲望。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/kinkbr/about]Patreon[/url]]
